For each allocation compute exact independent vote-mask probabilities; strict-majority masks succeed outright, other masks use A/(A+sum of dissenting levels). At most8 senators/candies makes exhaustive allocation practical and preserves the distinction between voting and appeal.

targets.review_note: Partition assignments by the earliest completion of a length-k black run. Linear avoidance DP subtracts only assignments where a first run just appears; its preceding character must be opposite or the start of the string. Count suffix assignments containing a white k-run by total assignments minus reverse white-run avoidance. The suffix starts after the first black run, ensuring disjointness without double-counting.

targets.review_note: Planar grid duality turns a four-neighbor route separator into an eight-connected obstacle chain between the two boundary arcs separated by start/end. Union existing obstacles and propagate boundary flags. If no existing separator, test one added rock at every neighboring cell and endpoint neighbor; any one-rock separator must lie there. Two rocks always isolate the start because both dimensions are at least2. Endpoints are never candidates.

targets.review_note: Reverse reachability after each number of operations is an interval[0,R]: every rounding map is monotone. A multiple x of an allowed prime p can reach all values through x+p-1 in reverse. Sieve the largest allowed prime divisor per x, scan each newly reachable x once, and grow BFS interval frontiers. Stalling certifies impossibility, otherwise binary-search each query first reachable frontier.

targets.review_note: Hall feasibility requires supply(S)>=demand of all clients whose allowed brands lie in S. Subset zeta transform computes those demands. Minimum positive removal count is minimum slack+1; if already infeasible the unique empty removal suffices. For optimal removals, all eaten heads lie in some minimum-slack set. Downward closure identifies admissible brand supports; binomial counts followed by subset Mobius inversion count exact nonempty supports once, avoiding overlapping-cut double counts.
